name: create_project
description: Creates a new architectural monograph, portfolio dossier, or publication project with target canvas format and Project Passport metadata.

name.description: Project title (e.g. 'Breton Granite Longère Adaptive Reuse')

format.description: Target canvas format. Defaults to LANDSCAPE_16_9.

passport.description: Standardized Project Passport metadata block (typology, location, work rights, role, software stack).
